decisions.reason: Persistent help text after a field is emptied does not change the separate requirement that existing placeholder text clear when the field is activated.
The decision concerns help-text visibility, not the editable-field mechanism, controlled completion behavior, or legacy control handling.
Field help-text persistence has no effect on table stability or pasted-content page margins.
The source decision does not change graphic bullet appearance or level-specific bullet requirements.
The decision about persistent field help text does not alter legacy-to-new template copy-paste behavior.
The source decision does not affect paragraph entry or manual line breaks after pasted content.
Persistent field help text is a field behavior and does not necessarily add or remove any style-set coverage requirement.
The source decision specifies help-text persistence but does not change any typography or spacing value.
Help-text persistence does not modify the required template theme colors.
The source decision does not affect Tab-controlled list levels or hierarchy alignment.
The field behavior decision does not alter the completed definition of the task-local assessment or its outputs.
The source decision changes a product behavior but does not change the requirement to provide an updated package after testing and fixes.
